sloka: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दीप्ताग्निसमतेजसः ।जगृहुस्तं ततो घोराश्चत्वारो रजनीचराः ।। ६.४१.८३ ।।।।
transliteration: rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā dīptāgnisamatejasaḥ ।jagṛhustaṁ tato ghorāścatvāro rajanīcarāḥ ।। 6.41.83 ।।।।

translations.english: The leader of the monkeys having spoken in that manner, Ravana the ruler of night rangers was overtaken by fury.
